create_toy_dataset: create a toy COCO-format dataset with bounding boxes, keypoints, and segmentation annotations from an image generator
register_toy_coco_dataset: register a temporary toy COCO dataset with local images as a context manager for testing
create_local_dataset: create and register a local dataset with images and annotations in a specified output directory
LocalImageGenerator: generate local RGB images and return image metadata dictionaries for a given directory and size
create_detection_data_loader_on_toy_data: create a training or testing detection data loader on a temporary toy COCO dataset
